title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 3.97 (versions follow prime numbers; 397 after 389): a record that grows at its end is not a book. When a book of the disk she knew changes, Luma checks two things: that what it was is still there whole (the print of its first bytes, as many as it had, is the print she kept) and that more than half of its lines begin with a number or a word with a colon. Both together say record (a diary written at its end is still a book; a settings file changes inside); a record becomes 'registro-disco' and is never eaten again. Books of the disk now keep their size too. Tested in a copy: a growing registro.log became a record, a growing diary stayed a book. Found and not yet cured: her reader has crashed (code 5) since v3.79. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v3.97: un registro que crece al final no es un libro. Prototipo de investigación.
